'''Shroomchips''' were a type of food available in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]] ate a handful of shroomchips which had been served in a bowl while he was in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] run by the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Baloob]] in [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]], which was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shroomchips first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

*''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' {{1st}}
